title: ARCANA WorldSim Scientific Authority Register
purpose: Persistent cross-cutting inventory of existing scientific authority. It is a governance register, not a scientific generator.

governance_rules.requirement: Presence of authority does not imply sufficiency for every downstream use.
An upstream authority cannot be silently reinterpreted as a downstream physical property.
ABSENT_AFTER_AUDIT requires a sufficiently scoped recovery/audit and provenance evidence.
Consult this register before broad recovery, provider introduction, new model, simulation, or materialization.
Prefer reusable governed authority when its semantic ceiling covers the consumer.
No downstream stage may infer beyond the registered semantic ceiling without an explicit gate.
PARTIAL_AUTHORITY or SEMANTICALLY_LIMITED requires an exact gap definition before a new provider or simulation.
A new simulation for a covered domain requires explicit adjudication of insufficiency.
